WITH same_stores AS (
    SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    INTERSECT
    SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008
)
SELECT
    sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM same_stores)) AS sales_2009,
    sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM same_stores)) AS sales_2008,
    (
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM same_stores))
        - sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM same_stores))
    ) * 100.0 / nullif(
        sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM same_stores)),
        0
    ) AS same_store_sales_growth_pct
FROM retail.FactSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
